title: Resolve known rules-pack ambiguities as campaign rulings
description:
Objective
Implement pre-adjudication resolution for unresolved RulesAmbiguity metadata when no campaign ruling exists.

Required behavior
Look up ambiguity metadata from the active rules stack by stable ID, check campaign storage for an active linked ruling, and when unresolved surface the published uncertainty instead of inventing certainty. Ask the player to choose among known interpretation IDs; persist the player-approved result as prose ruling with ambiguity/interpretation provenance; make it prospectively active and available to both model contexts. Required scenario: "Can I mix a ghast and a wight?" surfaces ambiguity:create-undead-ghast-wight-composition and can persist either homogeneous-alternative or mixed-within-total. Also cover ambiguity:find-familiar-permanent-dismissal-after-zero-hp.

Architecture and references
Consume PR #419 RulesAmbiguity output from eshyra-o9bd.18.7.9. Store only campaign prose/provenance via eshyra-jhpt.2; never write a winner/default back to the immutable pack. Use shared context from eshyra-jhpt.3-.4.

Non-goals
No model-selected canonical winner; no campaign ruling without player approval; no house-rule creation for clear canonical conflicts; no resolution of ordinary contextual judgments; no arbitrary prompt/retrieval optimization.
acceptance_criteria:
Create Undead explicit question and Find Familiar unresolved question both surface source uncertainty and known interpretations; an approved choice creates one durable prose ruling linked to ambiguity and interpretation IDs; an existing active ruling prevents re-prompting; declined/no choice creates nothing; DM/auditor receive the same resulting prose; pack data remains unchanged.

ADR 0020 TRANSITION AMENDMENT A2 (integrated transition design section 8.3, R5;
accepted as the deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8, PR #485, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282): define how an active ambiguity ruling
is made available to bounded deterministic capability preflight where execution
depends on it, not only to DM and auditor context. Today no path exists from a
campaign ruling to capability code.

The verified concrete case: magic-item:cube-of-force operation press-face-1 from
state face-1 hits transition resetsDuration { kind: 'source-ambiguity',
ambiguityId: 'ambiguity:cube-of-force-same-face-duration-reset' }, and
state/itemState.ts matchStateTransition throws ItemStateAmbiguityError carrying
the ambiguity and interpretation IDs. A ruling selecting same-face-resets or
different-face-only-resets is exactly what would unblock it. Verified ordering
constraint: assertMagicItemOperationReady runs at itemState.ts:1888, BEFORE the
first matchStateTransition call at :1934, and every press-face-* operation clause
on that record is engine-pending, so readiness throws first and the ambiguity
error is currently unreachable through use_item. A2 must therefore be designed
WITH the eshyra-olc5 readiness owner (see eshyra-olc5.6, transition W13), not
against it: a ruling does not make an engine-pending clause ready, and a
capability may never consult a ruling that did not come through this runtime.

This may be satisfied as an acceptance criterion here or as a new child under
eshyra-jhpt; either way the ownership stays here. The discovery-side consumer
eshyra-o9bd.19.13 (transition W11) depends on this output and may not substitute
a discovery-local ruling store or resolver. Probe P7 of the transition design
expects both outcomes: with no active ruling the packet carries the ambiguity,
both interpretations, and an explicit unresolved state; with an active ruling the
packet carries the ruling beside the ambiguity and the capability preflight still
reports blocked.
notes: Delivered on branch eshyra-jhpt; PR opened https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/526 at head eeab5eb (2026-09-05). Stays in_progress until merge.
